CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is large enemy scale (20-40 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a BRUISER unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Laurel Butcher, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Major.
Creature Category: Hollow Creature.
Combat Role: BRUISER.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW LAUREL BUTCHER — A muscular faceless gladiator with bronze laurel fused to its skull.

BODY: Muscular, powerful humanoid — 20-25 feet. Unlike the thin, emaciated Hollow forms, the Laurel Butcher is BUILT — broad shoulders, thick arms, powerful legs. But the body is still void-stuff — charcoal-black, dense, compressed absence given MUSCLE. The form looks like a gladiator's physique, but wrong — the muscles are too defined, too sharp, like a sculpture that is being eroded. Negative-space wounds across the arms and torso show ACTIVE NOTHING inside. The skin (void-stuff) has a faint marble-like texture — this creature has consumed an Olympian-adjacent culture and is WEARING its marble aesthetic.

MASK: No mask — instead, a broken bronze laurel wreath is FUSED directly to the skull. The laurel is cracked, partially melted, with white fracture cracks running through the bronze. Where the face should be beneath the laurel: nothing. Smooth void-stuff, no features, no eyes, no mouth. The laurel sits on a face that does not exist.

ARMS: Massive, muscular arms ending in void-stuff fists. No weapons — the fists ARE the weapon. The arms are wrapped in torn strips of what was once Olympian-adjacent fabric — now charcoal-black, erasing patterns visible. The arms look like they were carved from marble that has been hollowed out and filled with nothing.

CRACKS: White fracture cracks run through the body like broken marble — NOT the random cracks of a Wretch, but the deliberate cracks of a sculpture that has been damaged. The cracks follow anatomical lines — along muscles, across the chest, down the arms. The cracks should look like a marble statue that has been shattered and reassembled with void-stuff filling the gaps.

GATE STONE: A broken Olympian-adjacent Gate fragment (white marble-stone with golden cracks) is embedded in the right shoulder — a column-capital fragment fused to the void-stuff body. The stone is cracked, with cold white anti-light (NOT gold) seeping from the seams.

POSE: Standing in a gladiator's ready stance — feet apart, fists raised, head slightly lowered. Not charging — WAITING. The pose of a champion entering the arena, but the champion has no face. The broken laurel catches anti-light. The stance should feel like a fighter's pose that has been frozen and emptied.

SCALE: 20-25 feet. Low camera angle, looking up at the powerful gladiator form. Broken arena-rubble at its feet — shattered marble fragments, broken column pieces. The Laurel Butcher should look like a statue of a champion that has been hollowed out.

GROUND: The ground around the Laurel Butcher is covered in broken marble fragments — shattered statues, column pieces, arena debris — all being erased. White fracture lines in geometric patterns (the ghost of an arena floor). Ash falling upward. The earth looks like the floor of a colosseum that has been emptied of all glory.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment that looks like an ARENA — but wrong. Broken amphitheater seating visible in the void-fog, shattered columns, a collapsed archway. The space feels like a stadium that has been forgotten. Palette: charcoal-black, marble-white (fading), cold white, bronze-dark, faint laurel-gold (fading to void).

VFX: White fracture cracks following muscle lines. Bronze laurel catching anti-light. Void-stuff muscles looking like hollowed marble. Anti-light absorption — the most athletic, powerful Hollow form, making the absence of life MORE visible.

SILHOUETTE: Muscular, broad, fists raised, laurel on head. Reads as a bruiser/fighter unit — the gladiator physique and laurel are the primary identifiers. Distinct from the Oath-Eater (which is beast-like and heavy) — the Laurel Butcher is athletic and martial.
